_comment: src/assets/objects/log.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
広葉樹を倒して玉切りにした丸太（src/assets/world-codex/timber.yaml）。
**配置を描いて渡す（sketch: log）。** 生成では姿勢と太さが決まらない（26枚で0。
prompts/objects.json の log 参照）。形が単純なぶん、下絵で決めてしまう方が速い。
**太い枝（thick_branch）と並んで落ちる。** 広葉樹を倒すと丸太2本と太い枝3本が同時に出るので、
並んだときに紛れないことが第一の要件。分けるのは「先細りが無いこと」と「木口」の2点で、
編集の指示でも先細り・節・側枝を名指しで否定する。
**木口を製材の切り口にしない。** 島にあるのは石斧だけなので、面は斧で叩き割った跡にする。
**奥へ細くなるのは遠近であって先細りではない。** 太い枝と分ける軸がそこなので、編集の指示で
「perspective であって tapering ではない」と言い分ける。
段は400、対角線へ倒す（diagonal）。20kgの丸太が1kgの太い枝よりカードの上で小さく見えるのを
直すため——太い枝は斜めに寝ているぶん√2倍まで伸びている（card_art.py の align_to_diagonal）。
下絵の時点で対角線へ寝かせてあるので、ここでの回転はわずかで、手前と奥の関係は崩れない。

edit.prompt: Redraw this flat diagram as a soft hand painted illustration on a plain empty white page, keeping the same layout: one log lying on the ground and running away from us corner to corner across the page, its near end down at the lower left and its far end up at the upper right, in exactly the same place at the same angle and the same length. Paint it as one solid round log of dry hardwood with rough furrowed brown bark wrapping right around its curved side. Draw it in perspective, so that the near end at the lower left is large and close to us and the log grows steadily smaller as it recedes towards the upper right: the log itself is the same thickness all the way along and does not taper, it only looks narrower at the far end because that end is further away. At the near lower left end show the pale cut face of the wood turned towards us, roughly chipped and split where an axe hacked through it. The far end is turned away, so no cut face shows there. The log has no knots, no side branches, no twigs, no leaves and no splintered ends. Nothing grows on it and nothing lies beside it. Keep the plain empty white page with a wide white margin all around, and put one soft grey shadow on the ground beneath the log, wider under the near end. Everything in the picture is clearly darker than the white page, and nothing has a white outline, a pale rim or a glow around it. Warm brown bark, dry matte surface, flat even lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
